body.prompt: A modern office meeting room in the evening, a middle-aged Korean man standing by a blank whiteboard after speaking, while seated colleagues look at their laptops and away from him. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
